text:
Alex: Quick sync 11am PT webinar - need X thread + LinkedIn post + 30s highlight clip. Target: eng/platform audiences. Who can take X thread?

Priya: Ill draft the X thread. Thinking 4 tweets: hook stat, 2 quick takeaways, CTA to register. Will create two hooks for A/B.

Jay: I can do LinkedIn long post + 3-card carousel. Need speaker bullets and a stat card SVG.

Noor: Ill queue design asks: stat card (1200x675), hero (1200x628), vertical 9:16 clip. Drop Figma links when ready.

Kate: Ill own inbound routing + HubSpot form. Fields: name, company, job_title, company_size, utm. Routing rule: high touch for company_size > 200 or job_title contains (SRE|Platform|ML).

Alex: Proposed UTM: ?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=scale_webinar_may

Priya: For the X thread copy Im planning short lines, e.g.:
- Tweet1: Hook: "Serving LLMs at predictable latency isnt magic."
- Tweet2: stat: "~2.3x lower per-token cost with batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)" + link to methodology
- Tweet3: micro-case: "how we cut tail latency for a large infra customer"
- Tweet4: CTA: reg shortlink + pin

Jay: LinkedIn variants: product-first, benchmark-first, and ops story. Sponsor with benchmark-first.

Kate: HubSpot form name: webinar_scale_may_2026. Routing pseudo:```nif company_size > 200 or job_title matches (SRE|Platform|ML):
  assign = SDRs_high
else:
  enroll = nurture_3_touch
```

Noor: Need sticker for stat card: add "internal benchmark, results vary by workload" small copy. Legal OK with that.

Alex: Post timing: X at 9:15am PT, LinkedIn 9:45am PT, sponsor start 72h before. Dry run day before to grab 30s clips.

Priya: Who volunteers to monitor replies live? Need 2 people (product + community). I can cover product replies.

Jay: Ill coordinate with design for carousel and ask for 3 speaker bullets. Also want a screenshot card of the chart.

Kate: Post-live follow-up: top 50 leads -> SDR outreach within 24h; top 200 -> segmented email + recording. Ill build saved views: webinar_top50_scale_may_2026.

Alex: Engagement idea: we should DM registrants who ask advanced product questions with an invite for 1:1. Agree?

Kate: Yes, but SDRs only. Community replies handled by volunteers.

Priya: A/B test plan: Hook A (cost stat), Hook B (latency pain). Measure CTR->reg conversion over first 48h.

Noor: Figma target: frames by EOD today. I'll tag all assets with: scale_webinar_may_v1.

Jay: Ads note: boost LinkedIn carousel + retarget X clickers. Budget: $2k LI / $1.2k X.

PostBot: Short link created: rwd.in/scale-may (primary), rwd.in/scale (backup).

EventsBot: Webinar page published (draft): https://rwd.in/webinars/scale-may-2026. RSVP draft live.

Alex: Final owners: Priya -> X thread + schedule; Jay -> LinkedIn + carousel; Noor -> design assets; Kate -> HubSpot + routing; Alex -> approvals + pin. Deadline: copy by Tue 10am PT, assets in Figma by Tue EOD. React with :+1: if good or note blockers.
